python3 << 'EOF'
import statistics

# Historical data: FY1929-1942 individual income tax receipts (in thousands)
# From treasury_bulletin_1942_07_page_76.txt - "Individual" column
receipts_thousands = {
    1929: 1095541,
    1930: 1146845,
    1931: 833648,
    1932: 427191,
    1933: 352573,
    1934: 419509,
    1935: 527113,
    1936: 674416,
    1937: 1091741,
    1938: 1286312,
    1939: 1028834,
    1940: 982017,
    1941: 1417655,  # Note: column shows 1,417,655 (with r/ footnote)
    1942: 3262800,
}

# Convert to billions (divide by 1,000,000 to get from thousands to billions)
years = sorted(receipts_thousands.keys())
receipts_billions = [receipts_thousands[y] / 1_000_000 for y in years]

print("Years:", years)
print("Receipts (billions):", receipts_billions)

# OLS regression: y = intercept + slope * x
# slope = sum((x - xbar) * (y - ybar)) / sum((x - xbar)^2)
# intercept = ybar - slope * xbar

n = len(years)
xbar = statistics.mean(years)
ybar = statistics.mean(receipts_billions)

print(f"\nn = {n}")
print(f"xbar = {xbar}")
print(f"ybar = {ybar}")

# Calculate slope
numerator = sum((years[i] - xbar) * (receipts_billions[i] - ybar) for i in range(n))
denominator = sum((years[i] - xbar) ** 2 for i in range(n))
slope = numerator / denominator
intercept = ybar - slope * xbar

print(f"\nslope = {slope}")
print(f"intercept = {intercept}")

# Project to FY2000
x_2000 = 2000
projected_2000 = intercept + slope * x_2000
print(f"\nProjected FY2000 (billions): {projected_2000}")

# Actual FY2000 from 2001 bulletin (in millions, need billions)
actual_2000_millions = 1004461
actual_2000_billions = actual_2000_millions / 1000
print(f"Actual FY2000 (billions): {actual_2000_billions}")

# Difference: actual - projected
difference = actual_2000_billions - projected_2000
print(f"\nDifference (actual - projected): {difference}")

# Round to nearest tenth
difference_rounded = round(difference, 1)
print(f"Rounded to nearest tenth: {difference_rounded}")

# Write to answer file
print(f"\nFinal answer: {difference_rounded}")
EOF
